findings.finding: The model permits 1–3 fragments in one cycle; the player chapter requires an entire cycle for each. Both chapters also need to retain actual active cranking, interruption and later-addition handling.

That one completed cycle seals every installed fragment. Three fragments from empty bench take 24+600=624 seconds; one takes 612; two take 618. Later additions need a new cycle. Preserve removal as actual 10-minute tool work, no reactivation. Add a batch-sealing example.
